patterns.note: A fixed-position left sidebar contains primary navigation and a detailed project list, while the main content area scrolls independently on the right.
The main content area features a vertically stacked, dynamic grid of images, varying in size and aspect ratio, creating a gallery-like presentation.
An extremely oversized, semi-transparent brand name is used as a background element in the main content area, revealing itself gradually as the user scrolls.

The left navigation sidebar and a bottom-left newsletter signup button remain sticky and fixed in place, while the main content area, including images and the large background text, scrolls vertically.

technique_notes: The page is structured with a fixed-position left column for navigation and a fixed-position element at the bottom-left for a call-to-action, allowing the primary content area on the right to scroll independently. A large, semi-transparent text element is layered behind the scrolling image content, creating a parallax-like effect where the text appears to reveal itself as the foreground content moves past.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, consistent sans-serif for navigation and body text, sharply contrasted with an extremely oversized, bold sans-serif for the background display text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (for the newsletter button), otherwise sharp corners dominate.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, with significant whitespace around images and a clear visual separation between the fixed sidebar and the scrolling content.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the use of an enormous, semi-transparent brand name as a background element that reveals itself through the scrolling content. This, combined with a persistent, fixed-position navigation sidebar, creates a unique, gallery-like browsing experience that feels both artistic and highly curated, emphasizing the brand's identity as a visual backdrop.
